characters.name: Karthik
characters.appearance: Mid-20s, slim build, brown complexion, short black hair, short beard and mustache. Wearing black-rimmed glasses.
characters.wardrobe: Light blue patterned button-down shirt, traditional white dhoti with a gold border, and black over-ear headphones.

characters.name: Miss Nova
characters.appearance: Humanoid robot with a sleek silver and dark grey metallic body. Features a stylized face with glowing eyes and articulated joints.

scenes.supernova_script: Karthik says: The AI English teacher that all of India is talking about is here with us today. Welcome, Miss Nova.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Hooks the viewer by introducing the viral AI teacher.
- Names English immediately.
- Establishes the podcast interview format.
scenes.supernova_on_screen_text:
THE VIRAL AI ENGLISH TEACHER
IS HERE WITH US TODAY.
WELCOME MISS NOVA.

scenes.supernova_script: Karthik says: Tell me, Miss Nova, are you saying people don't need years of grammar books or expensive coaching classes to finally speak English?
scenes.scene_summary:
- Sets up the problem with traditional learning.
- Questions the necessity of grammar books.
scenes.supernova_on_screen_text:
TELL ME MISS NOVA,
DO WE REALLY NOT NEED
GRAMMAR BOOKS OR
COACHING CLASSES
TO SPEAK ENGLISH?

scenes.supernova_script:
Miss Nova says: Exactly, Karthik. Old methods fail because you only read, you never actually speak.
Miss Nova says: You learned your mother tongue by speaking it out loud, right? English works the exact same way.
Miss Nova says: On the Supernova AI app, you don't type or read. You speak to me, and I correct your mistakes instantly.
Miss Nova says: We practice real-life situations, like job interviews or talking to your manager.
Miss Nova says: With just fifteen minutes of daily practice, most learners start seeing visible progress in about a month.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Lands the mother-tongue reframe (beat f).
- Explains the core mechanism: speaking instead of reading (beat c).
- Mentions real-life scenarios like interviews (beat e).
- Sets a realistic, hedged progress expectation instead of a guarantee.
scenes.supernova_on_screen_text:
OLD METHODS FAIL BECAUSE
YOU NEVER ACTUALLY SPEAK.
YOU LEARNED YOUR MOTHER TONGUE
BY SPEAKING IT.
ON SUPERNOVA AI,
YOU SPEAK AND I CORRECT YOU.
WE PRACTICE REAL-LIFE SITUATIONS
LIKE JOB INTERVIEWS.
START SEEING VISIBLE PROGRESS
IN ABOUT A MONTH.

scenes.supernova_script: Karthik says: I heard over one crore Indians are already using Supernova AI to learn English. How do you teach so many people?
scenes.scene_summary:
- Uses the approved '1 crore+ users' social proof.
- Sets up the personalization payload.
scenes.supernova_on_screen_text:
OVER 1 CRORE INDIANS
ARE USING SUPERNOVA AI.
HOW DO YOU TEACH
SO MANY PEOPLE?

scenes.supernova_script:
Miss Nova says: Because I don't teach everyone the same way. I analyze your speech, find exactly where you struggle, and build a personalized plan just for you.
Miss Nova says: And the best part? It is completely private. You can make a thousand mistakes at two in the morning, and I will never judge you.
Miss Nova says: Plus, I explain the logic in your own language, so you never feel lost.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Delivers the crucial personalization beat (beat a).
- Delivers the privacy/no-judgement beat (beat b).
- Confirms explanations in the user's native language (beat g).
scenes.supernova_on_screen_text:
I BUILD A PERSONALIZED PLAN
JUST FOR YOU.
COMPLETELY PRIVATE.
MAKE 1000 MISTAKES,
I WILL NEVER JUDGE YOU.
I EXPLAIN THE LOGIC
IN YOUR OWN LANGUAGE.

scenes.supernova_script: Karthik says: And they say practicing with you is ten times cheaper than regular coaching classes?
scenes.scene_summary: - Introduces the comparative cost benefit without a hard rupee figure.
scenes.supernova_on_screen_text:
10 TIMES CHEAPER THAN
REGULAR COACHING CLASSES?

scenes.supernova_script:
Miss Nova says: Yes, it is highly affordable.
Miss Nova says: Stop wasting hours scrolling through reels that never actually help you speak.
Miss Nova says: Give me just fifteen minutes a day, and I will help you speak English confidently.
Miss Nova says: Install the Supernova AI app today and start your journey.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Tight close with negative time anchor (scrolling reels).
- Positive time anchor (15 mins a day).
- Clear call to action to install.
scenes.supernova_on_screen_text:
HIGHLY AFFORDABLE.
STOP WASTING HOURS
SCROLLING REELS.
JUST 15 MINUTES A DAY
TO SPEAK CONFIDENTLY.
INSTALL SUPERNOVA AI TODAY.

scenes.supernova_script: Miss Nova says: Click install and download Supernova AI now.
scenes.supernova_on_screen_text:
Supernova AI
English speaking app
Install Now
